prose.subject: a small clearing holding a ragged hide-tent camp — a stone-ringed fire pit with glowing red coals, three broad hide tents, a small oil lantern on a tent pole against a dark tent wall, a metal shield and loot bundle leaning against the right tent; NOTHING FLIES, NOTHING MOVES — only light sources waiting for the runtime
prose.composition: a hidden watcher's-eye view between branches, the camp small and readable in the central opening; behind it a continuous dark wall of treeline, and above an open dusk sky in a smooth low-frequency gradient
prose.lighting: deep dusk — the fire pit the warmest brightest element, the lantern a small secondary warm point, all else falling into saturated teal-veronese shadow
prose.palette_extra: Veronese pine masses, amber-cinnabar firelight, ultramarine sky band;
prose.technique_extra: tactile matter on hide, raw timber and stone;
prose.mood: assessment + the last quiet before violence
